baselineDisplay.title: A Card From Jimmy
baselineDisplay.question: Does grandmother seem pleased to get a card from Jimmy? Why/Why not?
baselineDisplay.questionZh: 奶奶收到吉米送的卡片时，看起来很高兴吗？为什么呢？
baselineDisplay.text:
Does grandmother seem pleased to get a card from Jimmy? Why/Why not?

Read Jimmy's card to me please, Penny.
'I have just arrived in Scotland and I'm staying at a Youth Hostel.'
Eh?
He says he's just arrived in Scotland.
He says he's staying at a Youth Hostel.
You know he's a member of the Y.H.A.
The what?
The Y.H.A., Mum.
The Youth Hostels Association.
What else does he say?
'I'll write a letter soon.
I hope you are all well.'
What? Speak up, Penny.
I'm afraid I can't hear you.
He says he'll write a letter soon.
He hopes we are all well.
'Love, Jimmy.'
Is that all?
He doesn't say very much, does he?
He can't write very much on a card, Mum.

baselineDisplay.bodyTextZh:
请把吉米的卡片内容读给我听，佩妮。
我刚到苏格兰，现在住在一家青年旅舍里。
啊？
他说他刚刚抵达苏格兰。
他说他现在住在一家青年旅舍里。
你知道他是 Y.H.A. 的成员。
什么协会？
是 Y.H.A.，妈妈。
青年旅舍协会。
他还说了什么？
我很快就会写一封信。
我希望你们大家都一切都好。
什么？大声点，佩妮。
恐怕我听不清你的话。
他说他很快就会写一封信。
他希望我们都很好。
“爱你的，吉米。”
就这些吗？
他说话不多，对吧？
妈妈，他在卡片上写不了太多内容。
